'''Decipher staff''' lists people whose own sources show they worked for [[Decipher|Decipher, Inc.]], publisher of the printed ''[[Star Wars CCG]]''. Each row gives the role as the source states it and the years the sources cover. Their pages are in [[:Category:Decipher employees]].

The list leaves out people credited only on a design team, playtesters, volunteers such as [[Squadron Members]], and contributing writers. [[Talk:Decipher staff]] lists the people left off and why.
